root.command: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled, c.EmailAddress, c.AltEmailAddress, IIF(c.EmailAddress IS NULL OR c.EmailAddress = '', 'NO', 'YES') AS HasPrimaryEmail, IIF(c.AltEmailAddress IS NULL OR c.AltEmailAddress = '', 'NO', 'YES') AS HasAltEmail, IIF((c.EmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.EmailAddress <> '') OR (c.AltEmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.AltEmailAddress <> ''), 'YES', 'NO') AS HasAnyEmail FROM CustomersTbl AS c WHERE c.CustomerID IN (489, 325, 571, 776, 3609) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, COUNT(ro.ReoccuringOrderID) AS ActiveRecurringOrders FROM CustomersTbl AS c LEFT JOIN ReoccuringOrderTbl AS ro ON c.CustomerID = ro.CustomerID AND ro.Enabled = True WHERE c.CustomerID IN (489, 325, 571, 776, 3609) GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled AS IsEnabled, c.PredictionDisabled, c.AlwaysSendChkUp, c.autofulfill, c.ReminderCount, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE c.CustomerID IN (489, 325, 571, 776, 3609) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT InternalCustomerIds, IIF(InternalCustomerIds LIKE '%489%', 'YES', 'NO') AS IncludesGregJohnson, IIF(InternalCustomerIds LIKE '%325%', 'YES', 'NO') AS IncludesHeinrich, IIF(InternalCustomerIds LIKE '%571%', 'YES', 'NO') AS IncludesMaya, IIF(InternalCustomerIds LIKE '%776%', 'YES', 'NO') AS IncludesRidwaan, IIF(InternalCustomerIds LIKE '%3609%', 'YES', 'NO') AS IncludesUCT FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID = 1

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled, c.EmailAddress, c.AltEmailAddress, c.ReminderCount, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl ro WHERE ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ro.Enabled = True) AS RecurringOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OrdersTbl o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now())) AS RecentOrders FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE c.CustomerID IN (489, 325, 571, 776, 3609) ORDER BY c.CompanyName
